final_resume.summary: Computer Science graduate (B.Tech 2025) seeking a Software Development Engineer role. Proficient in full-stack development with Java, Spring Boot, and React; demonstrates strong problem-solving and attention to detail in building scalable backend services and responsive frontends.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker, ensuring robust error handling and code quality.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms. Piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students, eliminating double bookings through transactional integrity.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status. Deployed locally with Docker Compose for seamless development workflow.

profile_improvement_tips: Study and implement Data Structures (linked lists, trees, graphs, heaps) and Algorithms (sorting, searching, dynamic programming) in a portfolio project or LeetCode practice; reference them explicitly in project descriptions.
Build or contribute to a project demonstrating Distributed Systems concepts: multi-service architecture, eventual consistency, message queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka), or load balancing.

Refactor existing projects to showcase Object-Oriented Design principles: design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy), SOLID principles, and clear class hierarchies in code comments or a design document.
final_resume.growth_note: You have strong full-stack fundamentals and shipped real projects, but the JD emphasizes Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Object-Oriented Design—none of which are evident in your current profile. Gaining hands-on experience in these four areas will significantly improve your fit for this role.
